steps.description: The world: a central plaza with the giant card machine, ringed by 8 player bases and statues of 8 of the pullable brainrot characters, with a holographic card floating over the machine. Players start with $250 cash. Walk to the machine lever and hold E to pull a card for $100: a giant card flips out of the machine in public with a coloured rarity beam, so everyone nearby sees what you got.

A fresh pull at the machine: the player carries a just-pulled Cappuccino Assassino - EPIC rarity, earning $18/s - on their back, the plaza ringed by statues of the other brainrot characters. The HUD shows 5 cards already placed at home and earning. The cast is 18 brainrot cards across six rarities - Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic and Secret - and rarer cards earn more cash per second. A pull can also land a mutation: Gold (10% chance, x2 earnings), Diamond (5%, x3) or Rainbow (3%, x5), shown in the card's glow and name.

Inside the player's base: 6 cards placed on their stands and earning - the HUD reads $40,262 with 6 cards placed - and the locked rebirth stands wait at the back. After a pull you carry the card on your back, slowed (walk speed 16 down to 11); walk close to a free stand and the card auto-places, standing tall and earning cash every second. Tension: other players can steal a placed card with a 2-second hold, and a raccoon thief event raids an unlocked base every few minutes. Defend with your bat - one hit knocks a carried card loose - or step on the lock pad for a 60-second shield dome (90-second cooldown) that blocks all steals.

Rebirth, the progression loop. Rebirthing costs $2,500: your cash resets to the $250 start and all your placed cards are cleared, but you gain a permanent +50% income multiplier and +1 base stand (6 stands at first, up to 8). Each rebirth doubles the next cost - $2,500, then $5,000, then $10,000 - so every new run earns faster than the last.
